style.name: Accent ladder
style.basis: 3 screens: a newsletter home, a network analytics overview, a cap-table company home
style.idea: One brand hue at full strength only on small marks, and its pale tints doing all the area work: the active nav row, a plan card, badges and progress tracks.
style.colourBudget: 3-10%, nearly all of it as pale tints of the one hue
style.signature: The full hue goes only on small marks: the one filled-button style, the data series and the active nav icon. Its 50-200 tints carry every area: the active nav row (tint fill with the dark ink of the hue), the plan or trial card, badges and progress tracks. The primary action may instead be near-black, as on the study's newsletter home.
identity: The ladder built from the brand's own hue (its logo, the brief's object) in place of the dealt raspberry: the full hue on small marks, its pale tints on areas, never violet or indigo.
The product's objects in the lead block: hotel properties, room categories, partner accounts with their status.
A ground one level toward the hue's palest tint (#f5f6f7) so the page and the tints read as one family.
avoid: the full hue on large areas
a gradient on buttons or cards
a left accent bar on top of heavy shadows
style.notes: StayHub Admin Design System based on accent-ladder with brand Teal #0E6B6F and Be Vietnam Pro.

shell.name: Open plane

numbers.activeItem: soft teal tint pill (#e6f4f5), ink #073b3d with 3px left indicator in #0e6b6f
numbers.topBar: 56px sticky bar with breadcrumb and user menu
numbers.canvas: fluid with 24-32px padding on desktop, 16px on mobile

shell.blueprint: The labelled sidebar sits on the page ground or white surface with a 1px hairline between it and the canvas; a clean 56px sticky top bar holds breadcrumb navigation and account access. Primary nav grouped under 12px sentence-case grey labels, user row pushed to the bottom. Cards are white with a 1px border on the #f5f6f7 canvas, flat surfaces without drop shadows.
shell.phone: The sidebar folds into an off-screen drawer triggered by the top bar's hamburger button, with an overlay backdrop. Content takes full width with 16px margins.

pattern.name: Overview workspace
pattern.blueprint: Title row: 22-24px title on the left, quick action on the right. Main column with flat statistics cards and quick shortcuts.

pattern.name: Table with tabs and a filter bar
pattern.blueprint: Title row: 22-24px title on the left. State filter tabs on a full-width rule. Clean search & filters toolbar. Flat table with 12px muted headers, right-aligned numbers in tabular figures.
